journey-description: Software engineer since 2013, with experience spanning internal tooling, ERP systems, SaaS products, and AI-driven automation. My background in Design Thinking, IT Management, and Digital Storytelling keeps me moving naturally between code, processes, and people. I spent 7 years at Rivelli building 40+ internal applications, then joined iScholar — a Brazilian EdTech SaaS serving 100,000+ daily active users — where I've grown from Software Engineer to Senior and now Technical Coordinator.

description: Lead the technical operations of a support engineering team, running daily standups, 1:1s, ticket prioritization, and technical guidance to unblock developers and act as the bridge between support, engineering, and business teams.
Significantly increased per-engineer throughput by introducing AI-driven automation, MCP integrations, and process improvements.
Partner with engineering management on infrastructure and tooling proposals; surface metrics and improvements that contribute to USD 3,000+ in monthly operational savings within the sector.
Established system observability that did not previously exist, replacing manager intuition with data-driven prioritization and SLAs.
Operated with technical autonomy on complex projects, with active voice in architectural decisions across the full development cycle, from conception to production.
Served as a technical reference for the team, supporting developers and unblocking deliveries.
Led implementation and code review of the company's React Native mobile app, ensuring smooth deployment to the App Store and Google Play, and improving CI/CD pipelines.
Owned ongoing maintenance of the platform's REST API and mobile application across multiple releases.
Developed and maintained core platform products serving 100,000+ daily active users, contributing solution designs and improvements that were consistently incorporated into production.
Implemented Pix (Brazil's instant payment system) integration and ongoing maintenance of payment flows.
Owned mobile application maintenance and store releases (App Store / Google Play) and platform REST API maintenance.
Played an active role in UX/UI definition, balancing user experience with functionality and performance.
Recognized with the 2023 company performance award for creativity and innovation within the team.
Joined a multidisciplinary team to migrate the corporate ERP to SAP S/4HANA.
Extracted and structured data from the legacy system, generated import files for SAP, and developed integrations with business partners.
Maintained close collaboration with key users, SAP consultants, and external partners to ensure integrations met area-specific requirements.
Left the entire integration structure documented and fully operational for project continuity.
Built an internal ecosystem of 40+ applications covering finance, logistics, sales, HR, and inventory control, integrated via REST APIs and webservices.
Cut multi-day processes down to hours by automating operational routines via mobile and web interfaces.
Delivered mobile applications, real-time management dashboards, and embedded solutions with Arduino and Raspberry Pi.
Owned the full development cycle: requirements gathering with business areas, implementation, deployment, and end-user training.
Team recognized as strategic by leadership for delivering significant operational cost reductions.
